adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb` the job does `rss.items.each do |i| ... TopicEmbed.import(...) end` with no limit or batching. Since `TopicEmbed.import` can create/update topics/posts (DB writes) per item, a very large feed would make a single hourly job do unbounded work and potentially run excessively long or overload the DB. This is a concrete performance/operational risk introduced by the diff, but not necessarily a functional correctness defect by itself.
